summary: docker-mailserver packages a comprehensive email infrastructure stack into a single container instance. It provides standard protocols such as SMTP and IMAP alongside supplementary services like spam filters and virus scanners, using flat configuration files instead of relational databases.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want to run a complete, self-contained mail stack entirely through container orchestration and file-based configuration.
watchOut: Email server administration carries a notoriously high operational burden, particularly around maintaining proper deliverability, reverse DNS records, and IP reputation.
deployNotes: You will typically need to map persistent volumes for configuration and mail storage, and ensure standard mail ports are correctly exposed on your host interface.
